name: Ubiquitous Language Practice
purpose: Govern the recurring practice of discovering, negotiating, using, checking, and evolving one shared language inside one bounded context.
practice_steps: name the bounded context and language owners
identify the concepts required for the current goal and consumer
collect expressions and exact current usages before proposing new meanings
give each required concept one current Define disposition: reuse, specialize, propose, or open
write candidate meanings in formal, plain-language, domain-context, and boundary voices
map expressions to stable concept identities and typed relationships
check relevant conversation, definition, DomainSpec, formalization, implementation, test, and evidence surfaces for drift
route conflicts and material revisions to the named meaning owner
retain unresolved language as visible questions or residue
boundary: This discipline governs the recurring language-maintenance practice. It does not define terms, become the language it maintains, promote candidates, force one vocabulary across bounded contexts, accept a Definition Pack, admit a FormalClaim, or authorize implementation.
owner_route: CyberAlchemy v2 discipline-governance owner plus the named bounded-context language owner
